data.name: Raghvendra
data.gender_notes: Raghvendra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who protects the universe from all evils and sorrows, a deity revered by Vaishnavites. The name Raghvendra carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Raghvendra usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes protection, strength, and divine grace
data.etymology: Raghvendra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raghvendra total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference: Raghvendra was a prominent king of the Ikshvaku dynasty, ruling from 1415 to 1442 AD. He was known for his strong leadership, justice, and generosity. During his reign, he constructed several temples and patronized scholars and artists.

Raghvendra Swamy is the presiding deity of the Raghavendra Matha, a major pilgrimage site in Udupi, Karnataka, India. The matha was established in the 16th Century AD by Madhvacharya, who is believed to have appeared to Raghavendra Swamy in a dream and instructed him to establish the matha.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Raghvendra continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
